name: SN 2016cdd field (Hubble)
blurb: The site of supernova SN 2016cdd, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2016cddfield-hubble
story: Hubble returned to the place where supernova SN 2016cdd appeared, part of a census of the massive stars around the sites of core-collapse supernovae.

claims.text: SN2016CDD is a target of program 14762
The program is a census of the sites of core-collapse supernovae and their massive stars
